textual.text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

We have reached the morning and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah. All praise is due to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.

Kami telah memasuki waktu pagi dan kerajaan hanya milik Allah, segala puji bagi Allah. Tidak ada sesembahan yang berhak disembah selain Allah Yang Maha Esa, tiada sekutu bagi-Nya. Bagi-Nya segala kerajaan dan bagi-Nya segala puji, dan Dia Maha Kuasa atas segala sesuatu.
Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer

labels.value: Dua 2 (Morning Adhkar): Master of Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar)

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِك�� وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sins except You.

Ya Allah, Engkau adalah Tuhanku, tiada tuhan selain Engkau. Engkau yang menciptakan aku dan aku adalah hamba-Mu. Aku memegang perjanjian-Mu dan janji-Mu semampuku. Aku berlindung kepada-Mu dari keburukan yang telah kuperbuat. Aku mengakui nikmat-Mu kepadaku dan aku mengakui dosaku, maka ampunilah aku, karena tiada yang dapat mengampuni dosa selain Engkau.

Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi, faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can cause harm in the earth or in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Dengan nama Allah yang dengan nama-Nya tidak ada sesuatu pun di bumi maupun di langit yang dapat membahayakan, dan Dia Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui.
Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-'aleem
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
Glory be to Allah and all praise is His. (Whoever says this 100 times in the morning and evening, no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with a better deed.)
Aku rela Allah sebagai Tuhanku, Islam sebagai agamaku, dan Muhammad sebagai Nabi dan Rasulku.
SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih

labels.value: Dua 5 (Morning Adhkar): Morning Protection with Al-Mu'awwidhat

textual.text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
Recite Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, and an-Nas three times each morning for protection throughout the day.
Wahai Yang Maha Hidup, wahai Yang Berdiri Sendiri, dengan rahmat-Mu aku memohon pertolongan, perbaikilah segala urusanku dan janganlah Engkau serahkan aku kepada diriku sendiri sekejap mata pun.
Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq (recite Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, an-Nas)

labels.value: Dua 6 (Morning Adhkar): Dua for Good Morning

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
Ya Allah, kami memasuki waktu pagi dengan rahmat-Mu, dan memasuki waktu sore dengan rahmat-Mu, kami hidup dengan rahmat-Mu, kami mati dengan kehendak-Mu, dan kepada-Mulah kami dibangkitkan.
Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
Glory be to Allah the Magnificent, and all praise is His. (A tree is planted in Paradise for whoever says this.)
Maha Suci Allah dan segala puji bagi-Nya sebanyak bilangan ciptaan-Nya, keridhaan diri-Nya, seberat timbangan Arsy-Nya, dan sebanyak tinta kalimat-kalimat-Nya.
SubhanAllahil-'Adheem wa bihamdih
أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

We have reached the evening and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah. All praise is due to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
Kami telah memasuki waktu sore dan kerajaan hanya milik Allah, segala puji bagi Allah. Tidak ada sesembahan selain Allah Yang Maha Esa, tiada sekutu bagi-Nya.
Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
Ya Allah, kami memasuki waktu sore dengan rahmat-Mu, dan memasuki waktu pagi dengan rahmat-Mu, kami hidup dengan rahmat-Mu, kami mati dengan kehendak-Mu, dan kepada-Mulah tempat kembali.
A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq

labels.value: Dua 10 (Evening Adhkar): Evening Remembrance of Allah

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return.
Aku berlindung dengan kalimat-kalimat Allah yang sempurna dari kejahatan apa yang telah Dia ciptakan.
Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykal-masir
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya aku memohon kepada-Mu keselamatan di dunia dan akhirat. Ya Allah, sesungguhnya aku memohon kepada-Mu ampunan dan keselamatan dalam agamaku, duniaku, keluargaku, dan hartaku.
Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
Maha Suci Allah dan segala puji bagi-Nya (100 kali).
A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
In the name of Allah.
Dengan nama Allah (Bismillah).
Bismillah
أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and messenger.
Aku bersaksi bahwa tidak ada sesembahan yang berhak disembah selain Allah semata, tidak ada sekutu bagi-Nya, dan aku bersaksi bahwa Muhammad adalah hamba dan utusan-Nya.
Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves.
Ya Allah, jadikanlah aku termasuk orang-orang yang bertaubat dan jadikanlah aku termasuk orang-orang yang senantiasa bersuci.
Allahumma-j'alni minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin

labels.value: Dua 16 (Wudu & Purification): When Putting On Clothes

textual.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
All praise is for Allah who clothed me with this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.
Maha Suci Engkau ya Allah, dengan memuji-Mu, aku bersaksi bahwa tidak ada tuhan selain Engkau, aku memohon ampun kepada-Mu dan bertaubat kepada-Mu.
Alhamdu lillahilladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
In the name of Allah.
Segala puji bagi Allah yang telah menjadikan air ini suci dan menyucikan.
Bismillah

labels.value: Dua 18 (During Prayer): Opening Supplication in Prayer

textual.text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praises are due unto You, and blessed is Your name, and exalted is Your majesty, and there is no deity worthy of worship except You.
Maha Suci Engkau ya Allah, dan dengan memuji-Mu, Mahaberkah nama-Mu, Mahatinggi keagungan-Mu, dan tiada tuhan selain Engkau.
Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika wa tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuk
رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.
Maha Suci Tuhanku Yang Maha Agung (Subhana Rabbiyal Azhim).
Rabbighfir li, Rabbighfir li
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.
Allah mendengar orang yang memuji-Nya. Ya Tuhan kami, bagi-Mu segala puji, pujian yang banyak, baik, dan penuh berkah.
Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
Glory is to my Lord, the Most Great.
Maha Suci Tuhanku Yang Maha Tinggi (Subhana Rabbiyal A'la).
Subhana Rabbiyal-'Adheem
رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
Our Lord, and to You is all praise, abundant, pure and blessed praise.
Ya Tuhanku, ampunilah aku, kasihanilah aku, cukupkanlah kekuranganku, angkatlah derajatku, berilah aku rezeki, dan berilah aku petunjuk.
Rabbana wa lakal-hamdu hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih

التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ

All greetings, prayers and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and messenger.
Segala penghormatan, keberkahan, shalawat, dan kebaikan adalah milik Allah. Semoga keselamatan tercurah kepadamu wahai Nabi, beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya.

At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat, as-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin, ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.
Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat kepada Muhammad dan kepada keluarga Muhammad, sebagaimana Engkau telah melimpahkan shalawat kepada Ibrahim dan keluarga Ibrahim.

Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid, Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid

labels.value: Dua 25 (During Prayer): Dua Before Salam (After Tashahud)

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of the fire, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya aku berlindung kepada-Mu dari azab kubur, dari azab neraka Jahannam, dari fitnah kehidupan dan kematian, dan dari keburukan fitnah Dajjal.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabri wa min 'adhabin-nar, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
I seek forgiveness from Allah.
Aku memohon ampun kepada Allah (Astaghfirullah 3x). Ya Allah, Engkaulah Maha Penyelamat dan dari-Mulah keselamatan, Mahaberkah Engkau wahai Tuhan Pemilik Keagungan dan Kemuliaan.
Astaghfirullah
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
Glory be to Allah.

Tiada tuhan selain Allah semata, tiada sekutu bagi-Nya. Bagi-Nya kerajaan dan bagi-Nya pujian, dan Dia Maha Kuasa atas segala sesuatu. Ya Allah, tidak ada yang dapat menghalangi apa yang Engkau berikan dan tidak ada yang dapat memberi apa yang Engkau halangi.
SubhanAllah
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
All praise is due to Allah.
Maha Suci Allah (Subhanallah 33x), Segala puji bagi Allah (Alhamdulillah 33x), Allah Maha Besar (Allahu Akbar 33x).
Alhamdulillah

labels.value: Dua 29 (After Prayer): Allahu Akbar After Prayer

textual.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
Allah is the Greatest.
Membaca Ayat Kursi (Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal Hayyul Qayyum...) setelah setiap salat fardhu.
Allahu Akbar

labels.value: Dua 30 (After Prayer): Ayat al-Kursi After Prayer

textual.text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence... (full Ayat al-Kursi, Quran 2:255)
Membaca Surat Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, dan An-Nas setelah setiap salat.
Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum...

labels.value: Dua 31 (After Prayer): La ilaha illallah 10 Times After Fajr and Maghrib

textual.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things omnipotent.
Ya Allah, tolonglah aku untuk senantiasa mengingat-Mu, bersyukur kepada-Mu, dan beribadah dengan baik kepada-Mu.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

labels.value: Dua 32 (After Prayer): Dua for Best of This World and Next

textual.text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the next, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
Ya Allah, aku memohon kepada-Mu ilmu yang bermanfaat, rezeki yang baik, dan amalan yang diterima.
Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar

labels.value: Dua 33 (After Prayer): Seeking Refuge After Prayer

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in an excellent manner.
Tiada daya dan upaya kecuali dengan pertolongan Allah yang Maha Tinggi lagi Maha Agung.
Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
Dengan nama-Mu ya Allah, aku mati dan aku hidup.
Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.

Dengan nama-Mu ya Tuhanku, aku meletakkan lambungku dan dengan nama-Mu pula aku mengangkatnya. Jika Engkau menahan jiwaku maka ampunilah ia, dan jika Engkau melepaskannya maka peliharalah ia sebagaimana Engkau memelihara hamba-hamba-Mu yang saleh.
Alhamdu lillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
Recite Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, and an-Nas three times, blow into cupped hands, then wipe over the body starting with the head and face.
Ya Allah, lindungilah aku dari azab-Mu pada hari ketika Engkau membangkitkan hamba-hamba-Mu.
Qul Huwallahu Ahad (recite Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, an-Nas — blow into cupped hands and wipe over body)

labels.value: Dua 37 (Sleep): Dua for a Bad Dream

textual.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil. (Spit lightly to the left three times and turn over to the other side upon seeing a bad dream.)

Segala puji bagi Allah yang telah memberi kami makan, memberi kami minum, mencukupi kami, dan memberi kami tempat berteduh. Betapa banyak orang yang tidak memiliki pencukup dan pemberi tempat bernaung.
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might or power except with Allah.
Ya Allah, aku menyerahkan diriku kepada-Mu, menghadapkan wajahku kepada-Mu, menyerahkan urusanku kepada-Mu, dan menyandarkan punggungku kepada-Mu dengan penuh harap dan cemas.

La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, SubhanAllahi wal-hamdu lillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

labels.value: Dua 39 (Sleep): Upon Seeing a Good Dream

textual.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
All praise is due to Allah. (Upon seeing a good dream, praise Allah and tell those you love. Do not tell it to those who may be envious.)
Segala puji bagi Allah yang telah menghidupkan kami setelah mematikan kami, dan kepada-Nya tempat kembali.
Alhamdulillah
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
In the name of Allah.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Bismillah
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Alhamdu lillahilladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

labels.value: Dua 42 (Food & Drink): Forgetting Bismillah Before Eating

textual.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
In the name of Allah at its beginning and at its end.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْ��ِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
O Allah, for You I have fasted and upon Your provision I have broken my fast.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma laka sumtu wa 'ala rizqika aftartu

labels.value: Dua 44 (Food & Drink): Dua When Invited to Eat

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
O Allah, feed the one who has fed me, and give drink to the one who has given me drink.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma at'im man at'amani wasqi man saqani

labels.value: Dua 45 (Food & Drink): Dua for the Host

textual.text: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
May the fasting break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels send blessings upon you.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Aftara 'indakumus-sa'imuna wa akala ta'amakumul-abrar wa sallat 'alaykumul-mala'ikah
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts, and verily to our Lord we shall return.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Subhanal-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun

labels.value: Dua 47 (Travel): Entering a Town or City

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا

O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this town, the goodness of its people and the goodness of what is in it. I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people and the evil of what is in it.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.

Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa ma adhlalna, wa Rabbal-aradeenas-sab'i wa ma aqlalna, wa Rabbash-shayateeni wa ma adlalna, wa Rabbar-riyahi wa ma dharayna, as'aluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahliha wa khayra ma fiha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ahliha wa sharri ma fiha
أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (Whoever says this when stopping at a place will not be harmed until he leaves.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li Rabbina hamidun

labels.value: Dua 50 (Travel): Dua for the Traveler (From Family at Home)

textual.text: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
I entrust Allah with your religion, your trust, and the ends of your deeds.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Astawdi'ullah dinaka wa amanataka wa khawatima 'amalik

labels.value: Dua 51 (Travel): Dua at the Beginning of a Journey

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى
O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that are pleasing to You.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-'amali ma tarda
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Allahi Rabbina tawakkalna
اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahummaf-tah li abwaba rahmatik
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
O Allah, I ask You from Your favour.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer that is to come, grant Muhammad the privilege and the distinction, and raise him to a praised station that You have promised him.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammati was-salatil-qa'ima, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilata wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah

labels.value: Dua 57 (Masjid): Dua While Waiting for Prayer

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
O Allah, forgive my sins and open for me the doors of Your mercy.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahummaghfir li dhunubi waftah li abwaba rahmatik
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the noble throne.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
La ilaha illallahul-'Adheemul-Haleem, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen

labels.value: Dua 60 (Distress & Anxiety): When Anxious or Worried

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being overwhelmed by debt and overpowered by men.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani, wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli, wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal

labels.value: Dua 61 (Distress & Anxiety): Dua of Prophet Ayyub (Job)

textual.text: رَبِّ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
My Lord, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbi anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin
حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best disposer of affairs.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil

labels.value: Dua 63 (Distress & Anxiety): La Hawla Wa La Quwwata

textual.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
There is no might nor power except with Allah. (It is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

labels.value: Dua 64 (Distress & Anxiety): Dua for Ease in Difficulty

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Astaghfirullaha al-'Adheem alladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh
رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbana dhalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen
اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni

labels.value: Dua 68 (Forgiveness): Dua Between Adhan and Iqamah

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
O Allah, forgive me and my parents and the believing men and believing women.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahummaghfir li wa liwali dayya wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat

labels.value: Dua 69 (Forgiveness): Dua of Adam and Hawwa

textual.text: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbana dhalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen
لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
No harm, it is a purification, if Allah wills.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
La ba'sa tahurun insha'Allah
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction. Cure, for You are the One who cures. There is no cure except Your cure, a cure that leaves no illness behind.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma Rabban-nasi, adhibil-ba'sa, ishfi antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama

labels.value: Dua 72 (Illness & Healing): Ruqyah: Bismillah x3, A'udhu x7

textual.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I am wary of. (Place hand on the area of pain and say Bismillah three times, then this dua seven times.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhādhir

labels.value: Dua 73 (Illness & Healing): Dua for Someone Who Is Ill

textual.text: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
As'alullahil-'Adhima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adhimi an yashfiyak

labels.value: Dua 74 (Illness & Healing): Dua for Pain in the Body

textual.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
In the name of Allah (3 times), then: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I am wary of (7 times).
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Bismillah (x3), then: A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhādhir (x7)
اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
O Allah, let it be a beneficial rain.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Mutirna bifadlillahi wa rahmatihi
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of fear of Him.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatihi
رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbi zidni 'ilma
اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumman-fa'ni bima 'allamtani wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni wa zidni 'ilma

labels.value: Dua 80 (Knowledge): Seeking Refuge from Useless Knowledge

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not fear, from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa'u wa min qalbin la yakhsha'u wa min nafsin la tashba'u wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha
رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera
اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
O Allah, forgive me and my parents and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was young.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahummaghfir li wa liwali dayya warhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira

labels.value: Dua 83 (Parents): Dua for Living Parents' Well-being

textual.text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, and all believing men and women.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbighfir li wa liwali dayya wa liman dakhala bayti mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ

O Allah, I seek Your guidance by virtue of Your knowledge, and I seek ability by virtue of Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty. You have power and I have none. And You know and I know not. You are the Knower of hidden things.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inni astakheeruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'adheem, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub

labels.value: Dua 85 (Guidance): Dua for Steadfastness on the Truth

textual.text: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Ya Muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik
اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
O Allah, You have made my physical form beautiful, so beautify my character too.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma ahsanta khalqi fa-ahsin khuluqi
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alameen

labels.value: Dua 88 (Gratitude): Dua of Prophet Sulayman for Gratitude

textual.text: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to work righteousness of which You will approve.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah

labels.value: Dua 89 (Gratitude): Praising Allah Upon Receiving a Blessing

textual.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
All praise is for Allah, by whose blessing all good things are completed.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Alhamdu lillahilladhi bi-ni'matihi tatimus-salihat

labels.value: Dua 90 (Protection): Seeking Protection from Evil Eye

textual.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous reptile, and from every evil eye.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammatin wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can cause harm in the earth or in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-'aleem

labels.value: Dua 92 (Protection): Last Two Verses of Surah al-Baqarah

textual.text: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ

The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers: We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final destination. (Quran 2:285-286)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.

Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi, la nufarriqu bayna ahadin mir-rusulihi wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-masir
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell, from the punishment of the grave, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min 'adhabul-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
Glory be to Allah and all praise is His. (Whoever says this 100 times a day, all their sins will be forgiven even if they are as much as the foam of the sea.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah. (The best dhikr is la ilaha illallah and the best dua is alhamdulillah.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
La ilaha illallah
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad. (Whoever sends one salawat upon the Prophet, Allah sends ten blessings upon him.)
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ

Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity worthy of worship except Him. I place my trust in Him and He is the Lord of the Great Throne. (Whoever says this 7 times morning and evening, Allah will take care of whatever worries him.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
Glory be to Allah the Magnificent, and all praise is His. (Two words light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, beloved to the Most Merciful.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
SubhanAllahil-'Adheem wa bihamdih
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
SubhanAllahi wal-hamdu lillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar

labels.value: Dua 100 (Marriage & Family): Dua on Seeing Spouse

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
O Allah, I ask You for her goodness and the goodness of the nature You have created in her, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of the nature You have created in her.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inni as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra ma jabaltaha 'alayhi wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jabaltaha 'alayh
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what You provide for us. (If a child is conceived, the devil will not harm it.)
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaytana wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana

labels.value: Dua 102 (Marriage & Family): Dua for a Righteous Spouse and Offspring

textual.text: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama

labels.value: Dua 103 (Marriage & Family): Dua at a Wedding

textual.text: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Barakallahu laka wa baraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr
لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
Here I am O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayk la shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la shareeka lak

labels.value: Dua 105 (Hajj & Umrah): Dua at the Ka'bah (Seeing the Ka'bah)

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْ هَذَا الْبَيْتَ تَشْرِيفًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَمَهَابَةً وَزِدْ مَنْ شَرَّفَهُ وَكَرَّمَهُ مِمَّنْ حَجَّهُ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَهُ تَشْرِيفًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَبِرًّا

O Allah, increase this House in honour, esteem, respect and reverence, and increase those who honour and respect it — of those who perform Hajj or Umrah — in honour, esteem, reverence and righteousness.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma zid hadhal-bayta tashrifan wa ta'dhiman wa takriman wa mahabatan wa zid man sharrafahu wa karramahu mimman hajjahu awi'tamarahu tashrifan wa takriman wa ta'dhiman wa birra

labels.value: Dua 106 (Hajj & Umrah): Dua at Safa and Marwa

textual.text: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ نَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwa are among the symbols of Allah. We begin with what Allah began with.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Innas-safa wal-marwata min sha'a'irillah, nabda'u bima bada'allahu bih
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. (The best dua is the dua of the day of Arafah.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

labels.value: Dua 108 (Grief & Loss): Inna Lillahi (Upon a Calamity)

textual.text: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
Surely to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me in my calamity and replace it with something better.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, Allahumma-jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha

labels.value: Dua 109 (Grief & Loss): Dua for the Deceased

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, keep him safe and sound and pardon him, honour the place where he settles, make his entrance wide, wash him with water, snow and hail.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu wa 'afihi wa'fu 'anhu wa akrim nuzulahu wa wassi' mudkhalahu waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad

labels.value: Dua 110 (Grief & Loss): Dua for Patience in Grief

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ آجِرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَعْقِبْنِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
O Allah, reward me for my affliction and compensate me with something better than it.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma ajirni fi musibati wa a'qibni khayran minha

labels.value: Dua 111 (Grief & Loss): Dua at the Graveside

textual.text: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ

Peace be upon you, O people of the dwellings, from among the believers and Muslims. May Allah have mercy on those who have gone ahead of us and those who are to follow, and verily, if Allah wills, we will join you.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
As-salamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'minina wal-muslimeen, wa yarhamullahul-mustaqdimiena minna wal-musta'khireen, wa inna insha'allahu bikum lahiqun
أُعِيذُكَ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
I seek refuge for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous reptile and from every evil eye.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
U'idhuka bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammatin wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka sami'ud-du'a

labels.value: Dua 114 (Children): Dua of Prophet Ibrahim for His Offspring

textual.text: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Rabbij'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, rabbana wa taqabbal du'a

labels.value: Dua 115 (Children): Dua Upon Seeing a Newborn

textual.text: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
May Allah bless you in what has been gifted to you, may you give thanks to the Giver, may he reach maturity, and may you be granted his piety.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
Barakallahu laka fil-mawhubu laka wa shakarta-l-wahiba wa balagha ashuddahu wa ruziqta birrah
اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have made unlawful, and make me independent of all others besides You through Your bounty.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahummak-fini bihalali 'an haramika wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak

labels.value: Dua 117 (Business & Provision): Dua for Paying Off Debt

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overwhelmed by debt and subjugated by people.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal

labels.value: Dua 118 (Business & Provision): Dua for Barakah in Wealth

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
O Allah, bless us in what You have provided for us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma barik lana fima razaqtana wa qina 'adhaban-nar

labels.value: Dua 119 (Business & Provision): Dua at the Market

textual.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise. He gives life and causes death. He is living and does not die. In His hand is all goodness and He is over all things omnipotent. (Allah will write a million good deeds for whoever says this at the market.)
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamutu biyadihil-khayru wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ

O Allah, all praise is due to You. You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. All praise is due to You. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn
اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ

O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to, and bless me in what You have given me, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahummahdini fiman hadayt, wa 'afini fiman 'afayt, wa tawallani fiman tawallayt, wa barik li fima a'tayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt

labels.value: Dua 122 (Night Prayer): Dua for Laylat al-Qadr

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni

labels.value: Dua 123 (Night Prayer): Opening of Tahajjud Prayer

textual.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
O Allah, Lord of Jibreel, Mikail and Israfeel, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen. You judge between Your servants in matters in which they differed.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
Allahumma Rabba Jibra'ila wa Mika'ila wa Israfila, Fatiras-samawati wal-ardi, 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifun

labels.value: Dua 124 (Quran Recitation): Before Reciting the Quran

textual.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ

In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds — the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. It is You we worship and You we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path — the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favour, not of those who have evoked anger or of those who are astray.
Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, kami berserah diri kepada-Nya dan memohon petunjuk serta perlindungan-Nya.

Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim, Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, Ar-Rahmanir-Rahim, Maliki yawmid-din, Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in, Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim, Siratal-ladhina an'amta 'alayhim, ghayril-maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad-dallin

labels.value: Dua 126 (Quran Recitation): Dua Upon Completing the Quran

textual.text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
Glory be to You O Allah and all praise, I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You.
Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami memohon kepada-Mu kebaikan, pertolongan, dan ampunan-Mu dalam setiap keadaan kami.
SubhanakaAllahumma wa bihamdika ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk
